title: No new permission appears on Roles & Permissions
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Start on Settings, Roles & Permissions.
  • If you cannot set up any of the above, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The role editor opens.
  • There is no new toggle for credit terms.
  • Credit Terms is governed by the existing "Finance" sub-row under "Settings".
  • Move Customers is governed by the existing "Customers" row's "Create & Edit" column and the "View and Manage AP/AR Data" cross toggle.
  • The Settings sub-toggles are the same six as before the release (App Settings, Service, Parts, Finance, Data Import, View/Manage Wages).

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Credit terms", Confluence 963346440, version 3 (22 Oct 2026, "Renamed to Credit terms", Chris Ward), read 23 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11638, story SV-11680 (Story 11, Release day: what changes for existing users)

  • Key Decisions, Permissions: “No new permission is introduced.”
  • Key Decisions, Permissions: “On the Roles & Permissions screen these appear as "Finance" (a sub-row under "Settings" in the page-access toggles), the "Customers" row's "Create & Edit" column, and the "View and Manage AP/AR Data" cross toggle.”
